title: Forrest Hydrangea Meadows
version: 0.14 · Twenty ranked spells, five-slot spellbook and fluid movement

rules.roster: 16 free monster species active across24 roadside camps.
rules.artStatus: 104 globally distinct Amaal-style NPC models, 416 directional resident views, 64 new Amaal idle and sword-action poses, and Map A regional artwork.
rules.lifeStatus: 104 globally distinct residents perform free built-in daily tasks across seven towns, with animated work actions and reserved workstations. Rosepetal has no village NPCs.
rules.campRules: Camps appear only beside long roads. Breaking a camp permanently stops its spawns. Towns, home and boat crossings remain safe.
rules.placement: Loose wild plants moved off paving; sensible property fences and harbours; dense land-edge canopy and named exit openings.
rules.ground: Rounded road ends/junctions, grass and leaf detail, shoreline reeds, woodland canopy belts and groves.
rules.ferryTravel: Walk onto the visible ship for automatic quick travel; arrive safely off the boarding trigger.
rules.developmentTravel: All seven towns and the Rosepetal home estate are unlocked on Map A; instant travel preserves the saved journey.
rules.homeEstate: Rosepetal is Amaal and Raeez’s private home estate: one grand tower, an animal barn, farmyard and growing garden. It has no village NPCs.
rules.foraging: Wild fruit trees and berry bushes grow beside the long roads. Poison mushrooms grow in marked woodland patches at Rosepetal.
rules.practice: Practice dummies at Rosepetal provide a place to train at home.
rules.storyStatus: The opening story draft includes Raeez’s note at home. The full trail through the seven towns is still being written.

residents.artRule: All NPCs match Amaal’s art style, scale, proportions, outlines and shading. Distinct faces, clothes and professions.
residents.townCostumes: Lavender herbalists, golden-market traders, hydrangea river workers, stone-forge craftspeople, moon-lantern keepers, river-port traders and coastal fishers.
residents.appearanceRule: Each model appears exactly once in the entire world; all match Amaal’s pixel art style.
residents.workAnimation: Procedural tool and task motions use the existing directional resident sprites; jobs reserve a workstation before approaching and working.

dayCycle.npcAI: Free built-in daily routines with animated tasks, workstation reservations and waiting positions; no external API or runtime service.
